Tradewind Saturday Ride

Honolulu, HI · Road

Tradewind Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Honolulu, HI. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Rotates: Kapiolani (Town), Kailua (Windward) or Kunia / Blaisdell (Leeward); start map linked on the team calendar. About 50 miles, rides self-select into two or three ability and speed groups; aimed at advanced riders who race or want to.

For visitors

Open to the public if you follow the team's ride rules, navigate yourself and handle your own mechanicals. Check the calendar for the week's start; it changes every Saturday.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: rides self-select into two or three ability and speed groups; aimed at advanced riders who race or want to. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @tradewindcyclingteam the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tradewind Saturday Ride group ride

The Tradewind Cycling Team's Saturday ride is about 50 miles and changes start each week between town, the windward side and central or leeward Oahu. It is a racing team's ride, aimed at advanced riders, and splits into two or three speed groups. The team says the ride is open to the public.
